title: Time to first token, cold vs warm, in doctor and the dashboard
goal: Time to first token, cold vs warm, in doctor and the dashboard
acceptance: Owner decision 2026-11-26 in chat: "ollama a+b, c as option in dashboard".

Each local model call records time to first token and whether the model was resident before it (/api/ps before the call, or Ollama load_duration if the native route is used), kept as a small bounded in-memory series per model with no prompt text
/api/doctor and nerv doctor report median time to first token cold and warm and the sample counts, so the gain is visible; "no data yet" when empty; tests with a fake streaming server
privacy: Local Ollama only; test data is neutral and invented; no secrets; warm-up calls carry no user text.
escalation: Material scope growth or effort increase goes to the owner before adoption

effort.basis: Estimated 2026-11-26 at agent speed from the existing engine-provider, config and dashboard code; bounded edit plus tests. Not a measurement.
